| | de nas dbang bzhi pa'i don du/ bla ma ngo bo nyid kyi skur dmigs pa la maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bdag nyid che khyod bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*/ /bka' drin gyis ni bskyab tu gsol | | zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ gdong g.yogs la 'bru gsum brjod cing*/ bdud rtsis gtor bas byin gyis brlab par bsgoms nas lus skyil krung lag pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya byas la bla mas/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral mthar sbyin zhi ba nyid/ khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do/ /zhes gsungs par bsams pa'i don dran par byas nas | de la yid mnyam par bzhag go /de nas gdong g.yogs phye nas/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /btsud pa dang ni mthong ba yis/ /de ring sdig las rnam grol 'gyur/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyis ni 'chi ba yod min zhing*/ /mi thub pa dang mi chod pas | | cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /zhes gzengs bstod pa mdzad par bsam zhing*/ /brjod la don dran par bya'o/ /de ltar don dam pa byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag rdo rje'i rba rlabs bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas zhes dran par bya'o/ /dbang bzhi pa'o || || de nas gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum gyis dam tshig dang sdom pa bsdus te khas blangs nas | deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyod kyi slob mar gzung ba dang*/ /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /zhes pas lus dang longs spyod thams cad gtang rag tu dbul lo/

/de nas dbang blang ba'i yul dang*/ len pa po dang*/ len pa'i tshul gsum ka ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + snang la ) rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma ltar shes pa'i ngang nas/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi dngos grub kyang blang ba'i phyir/ oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /kye yi rdo rjer bdag grub mdzod/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha | | rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ / nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa ste/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes su chags/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems su bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag grub mdzod/ /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi yid la zhugs/ /sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid | | 'dod chags mnyam pa'i dam tshig mchog /ces pa dang*/ de nas bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa/ /bden pa de yis mgon bdag la/ khyod kyis 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung*/ /de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung*/ /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung ste lan gsum brjod do | | de nas gtor ma rnams sta gon gyi skabs ltar phul nas phyi nang gi lha rnams mchod pa'i phyir/

tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ lhag gtor bkra shis dang bcas pa'i bar cho ga las 'byung ba ltar byas nas/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la slar yang mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ji ltar 'dod pa rnams gsol ba btab nas/ las bsags pa 'bras bu dang ldan pa'i phyir | | bsngo ba dang smon lam yang rgya cher btab la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang | | gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces pa dang yi ge brgya pa yang brjod do// dkyil 'khor la ma bstim pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la | oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol | | sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra muḥ zhes pas gshegs su gsol lo/ /ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la bstim pa ni/ rab tu gnas pa mchog tu gyur pa'i phyir/ brtan par bzhugs su gsol nas/ gtor ma'i mgron rnams gshegs su gsol la/ gtor ma nyid kyang rol mo dang bcas pas btang ste/ bdag nyid kyi gnas gsum bsrungs nas/ las kyi rjes bsdus la/ gnas skabs dang rjes su 'brel ba'i rnal 'byor gyi gnas par bya'o/ /tshul 'di ltar rtag tu byas na dbang lam du byas pa'i phyir/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur te/ dbang bskur yang yang sbyin ldan na/ /skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yis skye ba bdun na ni/ /ma bsgom par yang rdzogs 'tshang rgya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dbang sbyin pa'i tshul yang*/ thog mar gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rten 'brel bsgrig pa rgyu dus kyi dbang dang*/ dbang gi tshul de nyid yang nas yang du len pa rgyu dbang lam du byed pa dang*/ cho ga de nyid rang gi ting nge 'dzin gyis len pa rgyu dbang ting nge 'dzin gyis lam du byed pa dang*/

'jug pa spangs pa'i dbang nyid mdo rgyas gnas skabs dang sbyar ba rang gis len pa dbang nyid ting nge 'dzin gyis lam du byed pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis cig car dbang bskur bar 'bras bu la mtshams sbyor ba ste/ dbang sbyin pa'i tshul lnga las 'di ni gsum pa'o/ /ma bsgoms par 'tshang rgya ba ni lam gzhan la 'bad pa cher ma byas kyang 'grub pa'o/ /gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ni zhar las 'grub pa nyid de/ 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na/ /'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ /ces gsungs so/ /dbang gi rnam par bzhag pa'ang bstan zin to/ /sangs rgyas grong khyer yid 'ong bar/ /bdag nyid zhugs nas dbang blang ba'i/ /tshul 'di dge slong dpal gyis bskul/ /sngags 'chang 'phags pa zhes byas sbyar/ /dge ba de yis 'gro kun gyis/ /bla ma mchog las dbang thob nas/ /yang dag lam gyis grol byas te/ /rdo rje 'dzin par 'jug gyur cig /dpal kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga dbang la 'jug pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ stan gcig pa'i brtul zhugs la legs par gnas pa'i dge slong dpal gyi 'byung gnas zhes bya bas gsol ba btab cing*/ 'phrul gyi yig mkhan 'jam nyeg ( ¡¶ zha ¡· nyag ) ces bya bas lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen byas nas dge slong 'phags pas/ me pho stag gi lo khrums kyi zla ba la/ dpal ( ¡¶ lu ¡· - dpal ) sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'o/ /bkra shis par gyur cig/ //༄༅/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + dpal kye rdo rje'i ) dbang gong ma gsum gyi ¡Ã lag len tshigs bcad ma ( ¡¶ zha ¡· cho ga ) bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo | | dpal kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshungs bral bla ma dam pa dang*/ / sgyu ma'i tshul 'chang sprul sku dang*/ /bde chen zag med longs sku dang*/ /gnyis med byang sems chos sku dang*/ /spros bral khyab bdag ngo bo'i skur/

/phyag 'tshal byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /de nas de dag bsgrub don du/ /dbang ni rnam pa bzhi po las/ /bum pa'i dbang bskur bla mas bstan/ /mchog dbang gsum po bri bar bya/ /ji ltar de yi cho ga ni/ /phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon song nas/ / snyim pa me tog bcas thal mos/ /gus pas btud nas gsol ba gdab/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa/ khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te/ /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa/ /sgyu ma'i spros pas rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yid/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje'i yid kyis dgyes/ /lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab/ /'bru gsum brjod cing gdong g.yogs cing*/ /slob dpon rang nyid he ru ka /yum dang gnyis su med par bskyed/ /mkha' gsang byin brlabs snyoms zhugs pas | | ha ha si si kun du ru/ /badz+ra dhṛka ces bya ba'i sgras/ /phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs spyan drangs la/ /zhal du zhugs nas 'od du zhu/ /yum gyi gsang bar thig ler gyur/ /slob ma'i lce la bzhag par bsam/ /slob mas kyang ni dran du gzhug | dngos su bdud rtsi myang byas la/ /ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gi ni// sems kyi rgyun gyi dbang bskur ro/ /'bru gsum brjod nas lus la bstim// rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog 'gags/ /de tshe bla ma yum bcas pa/ /mgrin par zhugs pas rkyen byas nas/ /gsung dag dpag med mgon du gyur/ / 'bru gsum brjod cing bdud rtsi yis/ /slob ma dam pa bsrung bar bya/ /gdong g.yogs phye la bha ga yi/ /dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i brda zhes brjod/ /lung bstan gsang ba'i mtha' rten te/ /longs sku'i rten 'brel 'grigs pa yin/ / dbang bskur gsum pa thob bya'i phyir/ /phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon song nas/ /me tog thal sbyar gsol ba gdab/

/bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung | | ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che/ /mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod | | 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs | | lan gsum gsol gdab gdong g.yogs bcing*/ /'bru gsum brjod cing bdud rtsi gtor/ /slob ma kye yi rdo rjer bskyed/ /mdun du rdo rje bdag med ma/ /skad cig gis ni dran du gzhug /slob dpon gyis ni 'di skad brjod | | lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ma/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma | khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis/ /de ltar gtad la tshig 'dis dri/ /bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*/ khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par bu spro'am/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*/ / bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed pa/ /bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur tam/ /zhes pas slob mar bdag med mas/ /dris par bsam zhing lan 'di gdab/ /bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*/ khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par cis mi spro/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*/ /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed pa/ /bdag ni ci dgar spro gyur to/ /slob mas de skad lan btab pas/ /de mnyes de yi gos bral nas | | dri med ( ¡¶ zha ¡· zhim ) pad+ma kha phye ste/ /bha ga'i dkyil 'khor legs par bstan | | de yi zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /e ma ho nga yi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas/ /ji ltar cho ga bzhin bsten na/ /de yi mdun na nga 'dug ste/ /sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa/ /bya ba pad+ma ji bzhin byed/ / bde chen rgyal po rang nyid de/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /de skad phan yon nyes dmigs dang*/ /bcas pas spro ba bskyed byas nas/ /slob ma'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa/

/sku gsum du ni byin brlabs te/ /de ltar skal ba mnyam par byas// gal te nyon mongs shas che na/ /'du shes byin rlabs dgos pa dang*/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par te/ /chos bzhi rtogs par byas nas su/ /tshul min yid byed spang bar bya/ /de lta'i sbyor ba la mkhas pas/ /snyoms zhugs dbang gi dwangs ma rnams/ /dbu ma'i lam nas rigs bdag khar/ /babs nas yum gyi rak+ta dang*/ /bcas pa 'dres pas gzas zin dus/ /de yi rlung gi nus pa yis// byang sems rim gyis dbang du bsdu/ /gnad gsum man ngag shin tu gces/ / bdud rtsis bsrung zhing gdong g.yogs dbye/ /kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ni// dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i brda zhes bstan/ /dbugs dbyung gsum pa'i mtha' rten te/ /chos sku'i rten 'brel 'grigs pa yin/ /dbang bskur bzhi pa bya ba'i phyir | | phyag sogs sngon song gsol ba gdab/ /bdag nyid che khyod bka' drin gyis | | gtso bo dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bka' drin gyis ni bskyab tu gsol/ /lan gsum gsol gdab gdong g.yogs bcing | | 'bru gsum brjod cing bdud rtsis gtor/ /lus kyis 'phrul 'khor ldan byas nas/ /dam pas de la 'di skad brjod/ /ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral mthar sbyin zhi ba nyid/ khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ /de yang rang gi sems nyid yin/ /thog mtha' med cing skye 'gag med | | dngos po kun gyi chos nyid de/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zhes/ /ngo sprod tshig gi bzhi pa'o/ /de yi ye shes skye ba ni/ /don gyi bzhi pa phyag rgya dang*// bcas pa rten can dus kun du/ /goms byed lam gyi bzhi pa'o/ /'gros bzhi'i thim nas grub pa gang*/ /mngon du byed pa bzhi pa ste/ /de ltar ye shes ngo sprad nas | | 'bru gsum brjod cing bdud rtsi yis/ /gtor nas slob ma bsrung bar bya

| | gdong g.yogs phye la don dam pa/ /byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ni// mthong ngo zhes ni brjod par bya/ /gzengs bstod bzhi pa'i mtha' brten te/ / sku bzhi'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin/ /mjug gi cho ga gzhan du gsal/ /de ltar smin par byas pa yi/ /mchog dbang rnam pa gsum po 'di/ /bla ma'i phyag len ji lta bar/ /blo dman gzhan la phan pa'i phyir/ /nyung ngus rtogs byed kho bos bgyis/ /'di la nyes pa mchis gyur na/ /dpal ldan mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /brtse bas bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /dge des 'gro ba ma lus rnams | | srid dang mya ngan 'das spangs nas/ /sku gsum 'bras bu thob par shog | dbang gong ma gsum gyi lag len gyi rim pa/ bla mas ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin du/ rdo rje 'dzin pa ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + chen po/ ) blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba'o/ / ¡Ã 'dis bstan pa dang sems can thams cad la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig /ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· - 'dis bstan ma ṇaḥ ) ༄༅/ /dpal kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga snying po gsal ba zhes bya ba

( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· bdag 'jug gyim gyin ma ) bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ khyab bdag gnyis med bde chen rtag pa'i sku/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i sprul pa rnam 'phrul ba/ /kye yi rdo rje dpal mgon phyag 'tshal nas/ /bdag nyid 'jug pa'i rim pa 'dir bshad bya/ /kye'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i thabs kyi gtso bo dbang nyid yin la/ de goms shing ye shes gsal bar mngon du bya ba'i phyir dbang bskur ba yang nas yang du blang bar bya'o/ /de yang blang ba'i yul/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las len pa'am/ yang na rang gis blang bar bya'o/ /de'i cho ga ni bsnyen pa sngon du song bas/ yid dang mthun pa'i sa phyogs su dkyil 'khor gyi sa bslang ba'i cho ga bya'o/ /de yang maṇ+ḍal khru gang pa la ba byung lnga dang dri bzang pos byugs pa'i mdun du/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ nang gi mchod pa dang ¡Ã gtor ma ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - gtor ma ) gnyis bshams la/ rang gis mngon par rtogs pa rgyas pa bsgoms la/ bzlas pa ci rigs pa byas nas phyag gnyis pa'i rnal 'byor du bsdus la/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dri'i thig le byas pa'i steng du me tog gi tshom bu bkod nas/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī zhes brjod la tshom bu de nyid skad cig gis pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ sa'i lha mo ser mo phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan zhing*/ dar gyi na bzas klubs pa/ zhi ba'i tshul can du bskyed la de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐ bsams nas | rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsams zhing*/

oṃ pri thi wī de wī sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥ hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas mdun du byon par bsams zhing*/ ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ yang rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo bzhir rim pa bzhin ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa ¡Ã gnyis su med par ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· la ) bstim par bsams nas/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī zhes kun la sbyar la/ gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ tsau rī pra be sha ya hūm̐/ be tā lī ban+dha baṃ/ ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes brjod pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ yang rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rigs lnga spyan drangs la/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsgom/ de nas mdun du bzed zhal bzhag la mchod pa rnams kyis rim pa bzhin mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī zhes kun la sbyar la/ ni ri ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + ta ) āḥhūm̐ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + gyis ) zhabs bsil | ¡Ã ni wi ti āḥhūm̐ gis zhal bsil/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - ni wi zhal bsil/ ) sarba saṃ sho dha ¡Ã ne ( ¡¶ zha ¡· na ye ) swā hās 'thor 'thung*/ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ¡Ã swā hā/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· - swā hā/ ) zhes pas mchod yon dbul/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe la sogs pas me tog la sogs pa nas rol mo'i bar du dbul/ nang gi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la | oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis dbul/ de nas gtor ma gnyis sbyangs nas/ dang po ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas/ sa'i lha mos gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā la sogs pas dbul/ mchod pa lngas mchod nas sa bslang ba'i bsam pa dang ldan pas/ ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin | | kye yi rdo rje khros mchod pa'i/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/

/sa 'dir dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud ky-i sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i don du kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas bdag nyid 'jug pa'i slad du/ sa'i phyogs 'di bslang bar 'tshal na/ thugasabartse bar dgongs nas sa'i phyogs 'di gnang zhing rjes su gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs kyi bu khyod ci dga' bar spyod cig ces rjes su gnang ba byin par bsam/ de nas gtor ma gnyis pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas bye brag gi sa'i bdag po bkug nas a kā ro'i sngags kyis gtor ma byin nas ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· la ) / bdag gis sa'i phyogs 'dir kye'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs kyi/ sa'i bdag po thams cad kyis sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la byin cig ces lan gsum brjod nas zhi bas bslangs la/ nag po'i rigs kyi bgegs rnams la drag shul gyi sgo nas bslang ba'i don du bgegs rnams bskrad pa'i bsam pas/ hūm̐ sa phyogs 'dir ni slob dpon bdag / dkyil 'khor rgyal po kye'i rdo rje/ /bzhengs kyis 'di na gnas pa'i bgegs/ / 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis/ /zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ aṣ+ta la sogs pa drag po'i sngags mang du brjod la bgegs bskrad do/ /de nas oṃ pri thi wī de wī badz+ra muḥzhes brjod la sa'i lha mo gshegs su gsol/ me tog gi tshom bu dang mchod gtor rnams bsdu'o/ /de ltar bslangs nas sa phyogs snyoms shing byi dor legs par byas nas ba byung dang dri bzang po'i chus legs par byug go / de nas dbus nas rim pa bzhin phyogs kun du lag pa gnyis bzhag la sa'i ma dag pa thams cad sbyang bar bsam zhing*/

oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yang yang brjod/ yang lag pas mnan zhing*/ sa phyogs nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ bhu khaṃ zhes yang yang brjod do/ /de ltar sbyangs pa'i sa'i steng du rang 'dug la srung ba'i 'khor lo rgyas par bsgoms nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar la srung ba'i 'khor lo mi bsdu bar bya'o/ /de nas sta gon bya ba'i don du/ gnas khang brgyan nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su ba'i lci ba chu 'o ma zho mar te ba byung lnga dang*/ dri bzang po dang bdud rtsi'i ril bu sbyar bas gru bzhir byugs pa'i mtha' mar mchod pa rnams kyis bskor/ nang mchod dang gtor ma lnga bsham/ bum pa mdzes shing gtsang ba gnyis mgul chings dang kha rgyan byas la/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug yungs dkar gyis brab cing | a mṛ ta'i sngags brjod la ma dag pa bsang*/ gser/ dngul/ mu tig byi ru/ mu men te rin po che lnga/ bri ha ti/ a par tsi ta/ bya gra/ kaṇ+ḍa ka ri/ ha sa de ba ste sman lnga/ 'bras/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ til te 'bru lnga / ga pur/ gur gum | dzā ti/ tsan+dan dkar dmar te dri lnga/ 'o ma/ mar/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsi/ lan tshwa ste snying po lnga/ bdud rtsi ril bu ste bcud de rnams dang bcas pa'i chus bkang la gos gtsang ma'i gzhi dang bcas pa rang gi nye 'khor du bzhag lha'i mtshan ma gdags/ rnam rgyal gyi bum pa'i steng du dung chos sam/ thod pa bum chus bkang ba bzhag la/ rdo rje la gzungs thag btags pa de'i steng du bzhag de nas phyi dro'i dus su rang dkyil 'khor gyi shar du 'dug sgrub pa'i grogs rnams kyang gral rim gyis 'dug la/ sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi'i gtor mas 'byung po'i tshogs rnams la bsngos la/ dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du bar chad mi 'byung bar gsol ba gdab/ de nas gtor ma gtang*/ mgron gshegs su gsol/ gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs la/

oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇa'i sngags brjod cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas byin dbab/ de nas las kyi slob mas zhu 'bul nas brtsams te/ bzlas pa'i bar gyis bdag bskyed dang*/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - dang*/ ) mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa'i bar tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang 'dra bar byas/ de nas rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis par bsdus la | dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su sa'i lha mo sta gon du gnas pa'i cho ga bya ste/ sa'i cho ga'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /de'i rjes la lha sta gon du gnas pa'i cho ga ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dri'i ¡Ã chu ( ¡¶ zha ¡· thig le ) bdud rtsi ril bu dang bsres pa blugs la lag pa g.yas pas mnan nas/ sa phyogs de swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bskyed nas/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur par bsams la dbang ldan nas brtsams te gru bzhir byug cing*/ oṃ me di nī badz+rī bha wa ban+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i ra ba bla re/ ye shes kyi me 'bar bar gyur par bsams la phyogs kun tu byug cing*/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod nas/ lag pa ma btegs par me tog dor ro/ /de nas srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ gzhal yas khang dur khrod dang bcas pa mngon rtogs dang 'dra la/ gdan rnams bsgom zhing dri'i thig le re bya/ lag pa ma btegs par me tog re bzhag de yang dbus kyi gru bzhi/ gzhan ma rnams zlum por bya'o/ /de nas dbus su me tog tshom bu bkod la/ hūm̐ shrī he ru kā ya na maḥ zhes brjod la skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das bskyed/ yang me tog bsnan nas/ naṃ badz+ra nai rāt+m+yā yai na maḥ zhes brjod la yum bskyed/ de nas shar nas rim pa bzhin me tog tshom bu bkod cing*/ gaṃ badz+ra gau r+yai na maḥ tsaṃ badz+ra tsau r+yai na maḥ

baṃ badz+ra be tā l+yai na maḥ ghaṃ badz+ra ghasma r+yai na maḥ paṃ badz+ra puk+ka s+yai na maḥ shaṃ badz+ra sha ba r+yai na maḥ laṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍā l+yai na maḥ ḍaṃ badz+ra ḍoṃ bi n+yai na maḥ zhes brjod cing lha mo rnams rim pa bzhin bskyed | de dag gi skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya/ dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab pa'i bar mngon rtogs ltar bya'o/ /de ltar bsgrubs nas mchod pa bya ba ni mdun du bzed zhal bzhag pa'i nang du chu bzhi 'bul zhing rol mo'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin mchod la/ gos zung lha rdzas las grub pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pas mchod par bsam zhing*/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i sku la gsol/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog | oṃ bha ga wān la sogs pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra āḥzhes brjod la gos zung dbul/ de nas nang gi mchod ¡Ã pa dang ( ¡¶ zha ¡· pas mchod ) / yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod/ bstod pa rnams kyis bstod nas pus mo sa la btsugs | spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas byin gyis brlab pa dang | rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yid kyis/ hūm̐ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ / rig pa'i rgyal por phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dkyil 'khor thugs rje'i bdag nyid can | | mgon po bdag gis bri bar 'tshal/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*/ khyod la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ de bas bka' drin mdzad par 'os/ /'gro ba 'khor lo'i don mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /'bras gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /sngags kyi lha gzhan gang lags dang*/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang*/ /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang*/ /sems can bstan la dga' ba dang*/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan can rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/

/he zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /yo byad ci 'byor pa dag gis | | 'gro ba dag phyir bdag 'dri na/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ / thugs rjes thugs dpag mdzad nas su/ /dkyil 'khor par bcas thams cad kyis | | thugs rjes dgongs nas ¡Ã gnang ba ( ¡¶ zha ¡· gnas par ) mdzod/ /ces lan gsum brjod nas gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas rig pa 'dzin pa khyod ci dga' bar byos shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam mo | | de nas bum pa sta gon ni nang mchod kyis bum pa la gtor zhing a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bum pa gnyis ka paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i steng du bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba yangs shing ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + rgya che ba/ ) mgrin pa phra ba/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis khar brgyan zhing lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgrin pa dkris par bskyed la/ rnam rgyal gyi bum pa'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lte ba dang bcas pa'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la tshangs pa la sogs pa'i gdan dang*/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i nang du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan bsams nas/ thams cad kyi steng du ā li phrag gnyis gnyis zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re bsam/ yang de rnams kyi steng du kā li phrag gnyis gnyis las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re bsam/ de nas rnam rgyal kyi bum pa'i nyi zla kha sbyor dgu'i bar du/ lha dgu'i sa bon las so so'i phyag mtshan la sa bon gyis mtshan pa dang*/ las thams cad pa'i bum par nyi zla'i bar du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsam/ so so'i gnas su 'dres pa las/ rnam rgyal gyi bum par kye rdo rje lha dgu rang gis bsgoms pa ltar bskyed/ las thams cad pa'i bum par bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yas pas sna tshogs rdo rje nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur 'dzin pa/

zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba/ sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs bsam/ thams cad kyi skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya/ dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag pos dbur brgyan zhing bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan pa'o/ /de la phyi dang nang dang yid las byung bas mchod/ bstod pa byas la rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las sngags phreng 'phros pas gzungs thag la brten nas bum pa'i nang du zhugs | lha so so'i thugs rgyud bskul bas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bab pas/ bum pa gang bar bsam zhing gtso bo la de ba pi tsu dang*/ 'khor rnams la so so'i sngags bzla/ las thams cad pa la oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzla/ yang mchod bstod sngar bzhin byas la dung chos nas chu blugs pas lha thams cad zhu bar bsam/ bum pa sta gon no/ /de nas gtor ma dang po dgyes pa rdo rje'i cho gas gtang*/ gnyis pa chos skyong*/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi'i gtor mas gtang*/ de nas tshogs byin gyis brlabs nas/ longs spyod pa dang lhag ma'i bar tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang mthun par bya/ de nas me tog tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod

( ¡¶ zha ¡· + nas ) bzod par gsol/ yi ge brgya pa brjod nas dkyil 'khor steng gi nam mkha' la 'degs par bsam zhing phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ro tiṣ+ṭha zhes brjod nas nam mkha' la bzhugs par bsams la mchod pa rgyun mi chad par dbul/ de nas nyal ba'i rnal 'byor byas la dkyil 'khor gyi drung du nyal/ gnyid sad pa dang ldang ba'i rnal 'byor byas la he ru ka'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa dran par byas la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā badz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas sta gon gyi lha nam mkha' la gnas pa rnams la mchod bstod bya zhing mar me la sogs pa rgyun mi chad par bsham mo/ /sta gon gyi cho ga'o/ /de nas dgongs ka'i dus su dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gdan bzang po la ras ris bkram/ khor yug tu mchod pa kun g.yas skor du bsham/ gtor ma bzhi ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + bzhi ) dang phy-i rol pa'i gtor ma yang logs su bsham mo// de nas sta gon ltar grogs dang bcas pas sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma gtang ngo | | zhu 'bul nas bzlas pa'i bar sta gon ltar bya/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ dkyil 'khor a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gis bsgoms pa ltar srung ba'i 'khor lo nas gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed la/ gdan dgu'i steng du dus gcig la mngon byang tshan pa dgu las lha dgu cig car du bskyed nas gsal gdab/ de nas bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar bltas la/ dkyil 'khor la dkyil 'khor gnyis su med par bstim mo/ /de nas rang gi mdun bskyed gtso bo dang tha mi dad par gnas pa'i mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad zhal du zhugs/

thugs kar zhu/ gsang gnas nas bab | yum gyi mkhar dkyil 'khor rdzogs par gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas oṃ ā:hūm̐ zhes brjod pas mkha' nang gi lha dgu phyir 'phros/ de ¡Ã las dkyil 'khor ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - las dkyil 'khor ¡¶ lu ¡· + nas lha dgu ) dpag tu med par gyur/ ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + nas ¡¶ zha ¡· + 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros gyur nas ) sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ sems can rnams lha dgu'i rang bzhin du gyur/ spros pa'i lha rnams tshur 'dus rang gis bsgoms pa'i lha rnams so so la thim par bsam/ yang mkha'i rten gyi dkyil 'khor phyir 'phros/ dkyil 'khor de las dkyil 'khor dpag tu med par gyur nas snod kyi 'jig rten sbyangs gzhal yas khang du gyur nas | bcud kyi lha rnams gnas par bsam/ spros pa'i dkyil 'khor tshur 'dus rang gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim par bsam/ de nas rang gis bsgoms pa'i lha rnams kyi mig tu ¡Ã gti mug ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - gti mug ) rdo rje la sogs pa'i skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas srung ba'i 'khor lo kha phye bar bsam zhing*/ slar bgegs mi 'jug par bya ba'i phyir rdo rje gsor zhing aṣ+ta bzla'o/ /de nas sta gon gyi lha la mchod bstod byas la/ gau rī la sogs pa bzhis rang gi dkyil 'khor la bstim/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas/ rang la bstim pa dang dbang bskur nas rigs bdag rnams kyi rgyas gdab pa bskyed rim ltar byas nas/ dbang gi lha yang rang la bstim la sngags dang phyag rgya dang bcas pas srung 'khor kha phye ba bsdams la brtan par bya'o/ /de nas byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir lha so so la dmigs la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka zhes pa dang*/ oṃ naṃ badz+ra nai rā oṃ gaṃ badz+ra gau rī/ oṃ tsaṃ badz+ra tsau rī/ oṃ baṃ badz+ra be tā lī/ oṃ ghaṃ badz+ra ghasma rī/ oṃ paṃ badz+ra puk+ka sī/ oṃ shaṃ badz+ra sha ba rī/

oṃ laṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍā lī/ oṃ ḍaṃ badz+ra ḍoṃ bi nī/ zhes kun la ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + sbyar la ) sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya zhes pa la sogs pa rdzogs par brjod nas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas rang he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis gtso bo'i thugs ka nas bye ba ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· la ) / dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor 'dug la mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod pa phyi dang nang dang yid las byung bas mchod/ bstod pa rnams kyis bstod do/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi drung du sgrub pa'i grogs kyis rtsa sngags zlor bcug la/ rang phyi rol du song la phyi rol pa'i gtor ma gtang ste/ gtor ma chen po sbyangs la byin gyis brlab pa mngon rtogs bzhin byas nas/ gtor ma'i mgron bskyed pa'i lha dgu'i don du thugs rdo rje sngon po phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ rig ma sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa bskyed do/ /gzhan rnams ni 'dra'o/ /'bul ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ in+da man chad kyis chog la bstod pa yang mi bskyod rdo rje man chad kyis bstod nas phrin las gzhol ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + la ) / rdo rje'i glu blang*/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod nas mgron gyi gtso bo rnams badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod la gshegs su gsol/ 'khor bgegs la sogs pa rnams rang rang gi gnas su song bar bsams la lag pa sa la reg cing se gol gtogs la sarba duṣ+tān gats+tsha zhes brjod nas rol mo dang bcas pas gtor ma 'bab chu la sogs par dor ro/ /de nas rang dkyil 'khor gyi shar du 'dug la yi ge brgya pa brjod nas | bdag nyid 'jug par bya ste/ dkyil 'khor mngon sum ltar dmigs la/ gtso bo dang bla ma tha mi dad par bsams nas/ dbang rdzas ster ba la sogs pa'i bya ba rnams/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i he ru ka phyag gnyis pas byed par bsam zhing*/ dngos su rang gis byas la ting nge 'dzin rnams bsgom pa dang | sngags dang tshigs bcad rnams rang gis brjod do/

/de la thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ me tog bzung la dbang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa'i bsam pas/ bdag med ma yis mgrin 'khyud pa'i/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol | | byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te | | skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab bo/ / de nas byang chub kyi sems gzung ba'i bsam pas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /la sogs pa lan gsum brjod/ de nas gsang sngags kyi dam tshig ma lus pa gzung ba'i bsam pas/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /la sogs pa lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas rang gi gdong g.yogs par bsam zhing*/ me tog phreng ba lag tu bzung la/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ zhes brjod do | | de nas las thams cad pa'i chus rang la gtor zhing*/ a mṛ ta brjod la bsang | bdud rtsi myangs nas lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ de nas bla mas bu khyod su yin ci la dga' zhes dris par bsam/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /zhes lan gdab | des bu la ci zhig bya/ /zhes dris par bsam/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes lan gdab bo/ /de nas rang gi snying gi nang du zla ba kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems su bsam/ de'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems su bsams nas rdo rje snying gar bzung la/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod nas gsang bar gdams par bsgom zhing*/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi

| de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyis mdun du smra ba mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes brjod la dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor zhugs par bsams la/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ zhes brjod do/ /yol ba'i nang du 'jug pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i phyir/ bla mas bdag dam la 'jog par bsam zhing*/ rdo rje spyi bor bzung la/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya'i/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod pa ni phan yon gyi sgo nas so | | yang snying gar rdo rje bzung la/ hūm̐ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu bral te gshegs/ /zhes brjod la yang spyi bor bzung nas/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na/ 'dis khyod kyi mgo 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba ni ma bsrungs pa'i nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa'o/ /de nas bum pa'i chu 'thungs la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni | | rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la gzhag pa'o/ /yang spyi bor rdo rje bzung la | deng phyin chad bu khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bya ba de bu khyod kyi bya dgos so/ /nga la yang brnyas par ma byed cig byas na ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas te sems can dmyal ba chen po ltung bar 'gyur ta re/

zhes brjod cing*/ bla mas gsung bar bsam pa ni bla ma'i bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la gzhag pa'o/ /de nas ye shes dbab pa'i phyir bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la gsol ba gdab par bsam zhing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas chos thams cad rang bzhin med par sgyu ma dang 'dra bar ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + dran par ) byas pa'i ngang las/ 'og rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang nyid he ru kar bzhengs par bsgoms pa'i rkang mthil du/ dzhaiṃ me'i rang bzhin 'bar ba dang*/ snying gar sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po ljid pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang*/ mgrin par chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po āḥs mtshan pa dang*/ spyi bor rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang sngon zla gam has mtshan pas mnan pa rnams bsgoms nas/ bla ma la gus pa byas pas gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros 'og gi rlung bskyod/ rlung gis me sbar/ me rkang pa'i nang nas zhugs te song ba ¡Ã sum mdor ( ¡¶ zha ¡· gsum po ) 'dres nas lus thams cad gang bas nad dang bgegs dang rnam par rtog pa rnams bsregs | snying ga'i sa yang dmar por bsregs/ mgrin pa'i chu khol/ spyi bo'i rlung gis mnan/ rkang 'og gi rlung gis bteg phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad lus la char chen po 'bab pa bzhin bab nas lus la zhugs pas/ lus ngag yid gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du gyur par bsam zhing*/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha ā be sha ya/ ¡Ã ā be sha ya/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - ā be sha ya/ ) s+t+waṃ bha ya/ s+t+waṃ bha ya/ ra ra/ ¡Ã ra ra/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - ra ra/ ) tsa la ya/ tsa la ya/ hūm̐ a ha dzhaiṃ bdun brjod do/ /des ye shes dbab pa'o/ /de nas brtan par bya ba'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag nas lha rnams brtan par bzhugs par bsgoms la/ oṃ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + badz+ra ) tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod do/

/de nas bdag ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + nyid ) dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i phyir/ bla mas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba 'debs par bsam zhing*/ 'di skad brjod do/ /hūm̐ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang*/ /bsod nams rim pa'am de bzhin shog /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /'di la bsod nams ci yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces lan gsum brjod nas | rang gis gsol ba gdab pa'i bsam pas/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod | | la sogs pa lan gcig brjod nas/ rang gis lha la gsol ba gdab pa'i bsam pas me tog dbul/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes brjod la me tog phog pa'i lha des slar yang me tog de rang gi spyi bor bzhag nas byin gyis rlob par bsam zhing*/ oṃ pra ti gṛ h+ṇa ¡Ã s+t+waṃ i ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· swa mi ) maṃ/ satwa ma hā bā la oṃ zhes gsungs bar bsam zhing brjod do/ /de nas mig gnyis su oṃ re re bsam zhing | bla mas 'di skad du/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur pa/ rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /he badz+ra pa sh+ya zhes gsungs nas gdong g.yogs phye bar bsam mo// de nas bla mas 'di skad gsung zhing dkyil 'khor bstan par bsam mo ( ¡¶ zha ¡· ¡¶ lu ¡· la ) / /thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che/ /me tog gang du lhung gyur pa/ /de ni khyod kyi he ru ka /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu skyed/ khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes | | sngags dang phyag rgya'i byin gyis brlabs/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes | | dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*/ /sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis | | zhes gsung bar bsams la rang gis dkyil 'khor la rdzogs par blta zhing*/

dkyil 'khor dngos su mthong ba'i 'du shes bskyed/ de nas bla mas dkyil 'khor du bcug pa'i bka' drin dran par byas la/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so/ /oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor bdag gi de ring mthong*/ /oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur/ /sa ma ya hoḥ zhes ched du brjod do/ /dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'o/ /de nas dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la me tog bzung nas/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas dbang gi sngon du bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi nang du rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang*/ nyi ma'i steng du rang nyid kyi me tog phog pa'i lha de yin par mos la/ de'i steng du gdugs dang phyogs kun tu mchod pa thams cad kyis gang bar bsams nas/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pas bdag la bkra shis pa'i cho ga mdzad/ bye brag tu he ru ka phyag gnyis pa gcig gis bdag gi sdig pa thams cad til la bstim nas/ g.yas su ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i nang du bsregs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ/ da ha na bhasmi ku ru

( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + ye ) swā hā/ zhes brjod do/ /dri ma thams cad chus bkrus par bsam zhing*/ g.yon pas chu bskor zhing dor la/ oṃ hūm̐ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - hūm̐ ) ḍa ḍi ṭa ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + hūm̐ ) phaṭa ces brjod do/ /bum pa'i skyor chus nang gi dri ma sbyangs par bsam zhing 'thungs la/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ nish+tsa saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpa a pa na ye hūm̐ ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + phaṭa swā hā ) / zhes brjod pa'i mthar bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba'i byur dang skal pa ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig ces brjod nas dbang gi lha de rnams mgrin gcig tu gsungs par bsam zhing*/ phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa brjod pa'i mthar shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes gsungs par bsam mo | | bkra shis pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas dbang ¡Ã gi ( ¡¶ lu ¡· bskur ba'i ) dngos gzhi la | thog mar slob ma'i dbang drug blang ba'i don du/ dbang rdzas rnams mdun du bzhag la swa bhā ba'i sngags kyis bdag dang dbang rdzas bum pa rnams stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag dang dbang rdzas pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus pa las gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa kye'i rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa g.yas pa brgyad kyis rdo rje/ g.yon pa brgyad kyis des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma kī zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka sngon po rus pa dang*/ rin po ches brgyan par bsam/ gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐ bsgom/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas spyan drangs | dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rang dang dbang rdzas la bstim/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur | chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/

'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ de nas dkyil 'khor las sprul pa'i dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ lha mo drug mdun du bzhugs par bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsan+tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lngas/ dbang rdzas kyi bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar bsam zhing | sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /la sogs pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing*/ rig mas rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpas bkra shis brjod/ khro bos bgegs bskrad/ lha mos mchod par bsam/ dngos su spyi bor bum pa'i chus gtor/ bum pa'i chus rkang mthil yan chad gang | dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsamazhing*/ dngos su rang la mchod par bya'o/ /chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa gnas gyur/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i bag chags rgyud la bzhag par bsam mo/ /yang swa bhā was bdag dang dbu rgyan stong par bsam | stong pa'i ngang las gnyis ka pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du aṃ las rin po che aṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus pa las ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + gnyis ka ) rin chen 'byung ldan dgyes pa'i rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa g.yas pa brgyad kyis rin po che/ g.yon pa brgyad kyis des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa | gnyis ka'ang ser po rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan ¡Ã par bsams la ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· pa'i ) dpral bar oṃ la sogs pas gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ gnyis ka la'ang ye shes pa bstim/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur*/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i dbu rgyan du gyur par bsam/ de nas dbang gi lha rnams la sngar bzhin gsol ba gdab pas dbu rgyan spyi bor bzhag nas/

sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /rin chen dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa mi | badz+ra rā ga ta badz+ra sha li ho/ zhes gsungs nas dbang bskur/ yang bum pa'i chus kyang sngar bzhin dbang bskur/ rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ de nas lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ dngos su mchod par bya/ dbu rgyan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag par bsam mo/ /yang swa bhā was bdag dang dbang rdzas rdo rje stong par bsam | stong pa'i ngang las gnyis ka pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ dz+rīṃ las pad+ma dz+rī gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus pa las gnyis ka 'od dpag med dgyes pa'i rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa g.yas pa brgyad kyis pad+ma/ g.yon pa brgyad kyis des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka dmar po rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan par bsams pa'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ gnyis ka la ye shes pa bstim/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur par bsam/ de nas dbang gi lha rnams la sngar bzhin gsol ba btab pas/ lag pa g.yas par rdo rje gtad nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir | | rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long*/ /ma hā badz+ra hūm̐ zhes gsungs nas dbang bskur | yang bum pa'i chus sngar bzhin dbang bskur/ rkang mthil yan chad gang | dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/

dngos su mchod pa bya/ rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes gnas gyur | so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag par bsam mo/ /yang swa bhā was bdag dang dbang rdzas dril bu stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las gnyis ka pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus pa las gnyis ka don yod grub pa dgyes pa'i rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa g.yas pa brgyad na ral gri/ g.yon pa brgyad kyis des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka ljang gu rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan par bsams pa'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ gnyis ka la ye shes pa bstim/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur | de zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur gyur par bsam/ de nas dbang gi lha rnams la sngar bzhin gsol ba btab pas lag pa g.yon par dril bu gtad nas | oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes gsungs nas dbang bskur/ yang bum pa'i chus sngar bzhin dbang bskur/ rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ de nas lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ dngos su mchod pa bya/ dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed gnas gyur | bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i bag chags rgyud la bzhag par bsam mo/ /yang swa bhā was bdag nyid stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rang nyid bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan par bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ tshul 'dus pa las rang nyid rnam par snang mdzad dgyes pa'i rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ g.yas pa brgyad kyis 'khor lo/ g.yon pa brgyad kyis des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/

yum sangs rgyas spyan ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka dkar po rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan par bsam/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bstim/ dbang gi lha rnams la sngar bzhin gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis bdag gi spyi bor rdo rje dril bu bzhag nas | oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsā mi badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs nas dbang bskur/ yang bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur/ rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + lus ) rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing dngos su mchod pa bya/ ming gi dbang thob gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag par bsam ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + mo/ ) / de ltar rig pa'i dbang lnga thob nas bla mas/ dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba/ /gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha/ /chos rnams rang bzhin rnam dag pa/ /sangs rgyas ye shes blta bar gyis/ /zhes gsungs par bsam la/ de'i don yang chos thams cad sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i ngo bor shes par byed pa'o/ /de nas drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dbang bskur bar bya ba'i phyir/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par bsams la/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros | sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus pa las rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' ¡Ã sku mdog ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· - sku mdog ) dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pas rdo rje/ g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan par bsam/ de'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/

ye shes pa bstim | dbang gi lha rnams la gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes bsdus pa las grub pa'i rdo rje lag par gtad nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ khyod kyi kyang ni rtag tu zungs | | phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ e ṣa dha ra ya mi hi hi hi hi hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing rigs thams cad kyi bdag por dbang bskur bar bsams la/ rdo rje snying gar bzung nas snying gar yang de dang 'dra ba'i he ru ka bsam mo/ /yang bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur bas dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /de dag gis rdo rje slob ma'i dbang thob par byas so/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang blang ba'i phyir/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang tha mi dad par sprul pa'i skur bltas nas maṇ+ḍal phul la/ me tog bzung nas/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba/ / mgon po bdag la stsal nas kyang*/ /'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang*/ /slob dpon phrin las yongs su gsungs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa'ang bla na med pa gsungs/ /zhes gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas rang dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan dang*/ steng na gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ 'phan dang*/ ba dan dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can dang*/ phyogs kun tu chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ mchod pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor bar bsam mo/ / ¡Ã steng gi nam mkha' la sngar gyi dbang gi lha rnams dang*/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas gang bar bsam mo/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - steng gi bsam mo || ) de nas rang gdan gyi steng na skad cig gis rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa

| yum rdo rje snyems ma sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa | gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan par bskyed la/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas | sangs rgyas thams cad rang la bstim/ bla ma dang dbang gi lha la slar yang gsol ba gdab pas/ bla mas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi rang bzhin rdo rje rang gi lag pa g.yas par gtad nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs/ / phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ e ṣa dha ra ya mi hi hi hi hi hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing byin nas/ de kho na nyid ni 'di skad ces/ /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag pos bdag/ bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐ zhes gsungs zhing*/ de'i don yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi rang bzhin thog ma ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· mtha' ) med pa'i byang chub kyi sems spros pa thams cad las grol ba yin la/ de rdo rje 'dis mtshon pa yin zhing rang gi sems kyang de'i rang bzhin yin snyam du bsam mo/ /de nas gsung gi rang bzhin dril bu bdag gi lag pa g.yon par gtad nas/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/ /aḥzhes gsung zhing byin nas/ de kho na nyid ni/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa/ /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhes gsung par bsam/ de'i don yang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag pa ston par byed pa/

dbyangs kyi yan lag drug cu yin la/ de dril bu 'dis mtshon zhing rang gi ngag kyang de'i rang bzhin yin snyam du bsam mo/ /de nas rang gi phyag rgya rdo rje snyems ma lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can dang mnyam par sbyor bar bsam zhing bla mas/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlab/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis | | zhes gsungs par bsam zhing*/ de'i don yang rang gi lus lha'i sku phyag rgya dang gnyis su med pa de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i rang bzhin ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + yin snyam ) du dran par bya'o/ /de nas bla mas phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid rgyas par gsung bar bsam zhing*/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung*/ /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni khyod kyis zungs | | 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci 'dod par ni bsten bzhin du

| | rang gis lhag pa'i lha sbyor bas/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pas/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su bsgrags/ /yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /zhes brjod cing de'i don dran par bya'o/ /don bsdus pas rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig dril bu gsung gi dam tshig rang lha'i sku phyag rgya'i dam tshig ste dam tshig gsum dang mi 'bral bar gyis la/ sems can gyi don gyis shig ces gsungs nas rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur bar bsam/ slar yang dbang de brtan par bya ba'i don du rigs lngas bum pa'i chus bdag gi spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ sangs rgyas rnams ni la sogs pa gsungs/ rig mas rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpas bkra shis brjod/ khro bos bgegs bskrad/ lha mos mchod par bsam/ de ltar dbang bskur bas/ rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas dbang gi lha rnams kyis bdag la me tog gi char phab nas/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ zhes gsungs zhing ¡Ã mnga' phul bas ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - mnga' phul bas ) khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por gyur par bsam mo | | ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + de nas bla mas phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid sogs nas de'i don dran par bya'o bar/ ) de nas bla mas dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid gsung bar bsam zhing*/ dkyil 'khor zhes ni gang bshad pa/ /yid nyid dkyil 'khor dam pa yin/ / ¡Ã gzhal med khang zhes bshad pa ni/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - gzhal med pa ni// ) sems nyid gzhal yas khang brtsegs 'phags/ /de yi phyi rol gru bzhi ni/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// byams pa la sogs sems gang yin/ /thig skud bzhir ni yang dag bshad// thig gdab yang dag bshad pa ni/ /chos rjes dran pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /lta ba kun las rnam grol ba/

/ye shes thig tu bshad pa yin/ /rgyan rnams yang dag bshad pa ni/ /tshul khrims la sogs sdom pa'i mchog /dad dbang la sogs sems gang yin/ /ra ba lngar ni yang dag bshad/ /rnam par thar pa bzhi po ni// sgo rnams su ni yang dag bshad/ /ka bar bcas pa'i rta babs bzhi/ /yang dag spong ba rnam pa bzhi/ /dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi po ni/ kha khyer bzhir ni shes par bya | | sgo khyud ces ni gang bshad pa/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rnam pa bzhi/ /byang chub yan lag rnam bdun ni/ /phreng ba me tog chun 'phyang ldan/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad po ni/ /ka ba brgyad ces bya bar bshad/ /sgrib pa kun las rnam grol zhing*/ /ting 'dzin ye shes kyis brtags pa/ /lam gyi ye shes khyad par rnams | | rnga yab ces ni yang dag bshad/ /nyon mongs thams cad 'joms pa'i phyir/ /do shal zhes ni rab tu bshad/ /nyon mongs phyed ni 'joms pa'i phyir | | do shal phyed pa zhes brjod do/ / ¡Ã kun tu sbyor ba'i khyad par gyi/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - kun tu par gyi// ) nyon mongs 'phrog pas dra ba nyid/ /tshogs gnyis kyi ni sbyor ba yi/ /'khor lo bskor ba bla na med/ /ces pa rnams brjod do/ /de nas lha'i de kho na nyid ni/ dngos su gsung bar bsam zhing*/ bcom ldan 'das ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ gau rī me long lta bu'i ye shes/ tsau rī mnyam pa nyid/ be twa lī so sor rtog pa/ ghasma rī bya ba grub pa/ puk+ka sī byams pa tshad med pa/ sha ba rī snying rje/ tsaṇ+ḍā lī dga' ba/ ḍom+bi nī btang snyoms tshad med pa'i ngo bo zhes brjod cing dran par bya'o/ /de nas bla mas slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid gsung bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje slob dpon lus 'di la/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni rim bzhin gnas/ /'di yi gzugs kyi phung po ni/ /bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad do/ /tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma ste/ /'du shes pad+ma gar dbang phyug /'du byed de bzhin rdo rje rgyal/

/rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa/ /kun gyi ngo bo he ru ka /zhes brjod cing de'i don yang*/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas kyi ngo bor dran par bya'o | | rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi dngos gzhi'o | | dbang de'i mtha' rten rjes su gnang ba 'di rnams bla mas gsung bar bsam zhing*/ rang gis brjod cing don dran par bya'o/ /deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sras dang bcas par rnam rol phyir/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dga' ston bde ba'i mchod pa gyis/ /aḥzhes brjod la lha mo sgeg mo'i nga rgyal gyis sgeg pa'i tshul gyis mchod pa bya'o/ /yang*/ sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phang*/ / sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /des ni bcom ldan 'bral mi 'gyur/ / phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /oṃ zhes brjod pas phreng ba ma'i nga rgyal gyis phreng bas mchod pa'i tshul du bya'o/ /yang*/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - yang*/ ) lus can kun la dam chos kyi | | glu ni khyod kyis blang bar gyis/ /de yis bde bshegs dngos grub ni/ / myur du bde ba ¡Ã myong bar ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· thob par ) 'gyur/ /gī zhes brjod la glu ma'i nga rgyal gyis glus mchod par bya'o/ /yang*/ de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'du ba'i phrin las kyis/ / gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyis/ /hoḥzhes brjod pas gar ma'i nga rgyal gyis// gar gyis mchod pa'i tshul du bya'o/ /yang*/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas// brtul zhugs bzang pos legs bsgos pa'i/ /lus can bad ེ gshegs cha lugs su | | ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis/ /hūm̐ zhes brjod la bdug spos ma'i tshul gyis bdug spos ky-is mchod par bya'o/ /yang*/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - yang*/ ) sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pas/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par gyis/ /bh+rūṃ zhes brjod la me tog ma'i nga rgyal gyis me tog gis mchod do/

/yang*/ chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas/ /rdo rje chos dang 'dra ba ru/ /sems can ma rig mdongs pa la/ /ye shes sgron mes gsal bar gyis/ /pra zhes brjod la mar me ma'i nga rgyal gyis mar me mchod do// yang | sangs rgyas rnams la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang | | rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bsgos// gaḥzhes brjod la dri ma'i nga rgyal gyis dris mchod do/ /mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba brgyad do/ /de nas sems can gyi don bya ba'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ bla mas | bdag gi mi shes pa'i rab rib bsal bar bsam zhing*/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling tog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra ni tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥpraṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas me long la blta zhing*/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med | | rgyu dang las las kun tu byung*/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skye/ /zhes brjod la ¡Ã chos ( ¡¶ zha ¡· sems can ) thams cad me long gi gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar dran par bya'o/ /de nas dril bu dkrol zhing | thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med | | nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal | | zhes brjod la chos thams cad dril bu'i sgra ltar rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yin la/ de'i rang bzhin nam mkha' ltar stong par dran par bya'o/ / yang me long la blta zhing a badz+ra satwa/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long ltar/ / gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid gtso/ /gang yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems 'di nyid yin par shes par gyis shig

ces brjod cing de'i don me long dag pa la gzugs brnyan 'char ba ltar/ rang gi sems dag pa la rdo rje sems dpa' 'jug pa yin snyam du dran par bya'o/ /de nas mda' gzhu thogs la | hoḥde bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par byos shig ces brjod cing bdag la chags pa nyan thos kyi sems dang*/ /bdud dang mu stegs ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + byed ) kyi sems sun phyung bar bsam mo/ /sems can gyi don byed pa'i rjes su gnang ba'o/ /de nas chos bshad pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ / oṃ badz+ra he tu zhes pas rkang pa'i 'og tu 'khor lo sbyin/ badz+ra bhā ṣa raṃ zhes pas lag pa g.yas pas dung sbyin/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥzhes pas lag pa g.yon par dril bu sbyin/ aḥzhes pas lag pa'i dbus su pusti sbyin par bsam/ de nas bla mas gsung bar bsam zhing*/ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa' ི sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis// sngags spyod tshul gyi cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun kyang | khyod la rtag tu bsrung ba ( ¡¶ lu ¡· par ) mdzad/ /ces brjod nas thun mong gi chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang thun mong du byin par bsam/ yang*/ sems can kun la thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhin du rjo rje 'khor lo/ rin chen 'khor lo/ pad+ma'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor ro/ / sems can thams cad la chos kyi dung bus/ sgra sgrogs/ bshad pa gyis/ zhes gsungs par bsam zhing brjod la/ dung 'bud cing dril bu dkrol/ chos 'chad par dam bca' bar yang bsam mo/ /chos bshad pa'i rjes su gnang ba ste rjes su gnang ba'o/

/der ltar na dkyil 'khor las/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i brten 'brel mngon byas snyam du bsam mo/ /bum pa'i dbang ngo*// de nas bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur dmigs la/ rang rnam par snang mdzad kyi nga rgyal gyis gsang ba'i dbang blang ba'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su 'dug par bsam/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs la sogs pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar rang la/ gdong g.yogs bcing bar bsams la/ de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras bskul nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zhu/ thig ler gyur/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung ba bdag gi lce thog tu gnang nas/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gi gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro/ /zhes gsungs nas dbang bskur bar bsam/ dngos su bdud rtsi lce la bzhag de mgrin pa'i gnas su thim pas lus thams cad thig les gang*/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + rang bzhin brgyad cu'i ) rnam par rtog pa thams cad 'gag gsung rnam par dag pa 'od dpag tu med pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsam/ gsang ba'i dbang thob pa'i brdar gdong g.yogs phye/ dbang de'i mtha' rten du lung bstan pa ni/ bla ma sprul pa'i sku'i rnam par gyur nas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya bdag gi spyi bor bzhag nas/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton | | kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum du bhūr+bhu wa swaḥ ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + hā ) gang la ngas lung bstan pa 'di la dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis byang chub chen por mgrin gcig tu lung bstan par mdzad de/

sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no zhes lung bstan par bsam zhing brjod do/ /de ltar na bhā ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag rang byin gyis brlab pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas snyam du dran par bya'o/ /gsang ba'i dbang ngo*/ /de nas bla ma chos kyi skur dmigs la/ rang 'od dpag med kyi nga rgyal gyis shes rab ye shes kyi dbang blang ba'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor gyi nub sgor 'dug par mos nas/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*/ /ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che/ /mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yogs bcing bar bsam/ de nas rang nyid skad cig gis kye'i rdo rje phyag bcu drug par bsam la/ mdun du rdo rje bdag med ma lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can zhig bla mas bdag la gnang zhing*/ dga' ster gnas ste lha mo ni/ / sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis/ /zhes gsungs par bsam/ de nas lha mo des kyang*/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*/ khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par bu spro'am/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*/ /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed pa/ /bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur tam/ /zhes bdag la dris par bsam/ de'i lan du/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*/ khrag dang khu ba'ang de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par cis mi spro/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*/ /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed pa// bdag ni ci dgar spro gyur to/ /zhes lan btab par bsam mo/

/de nas lha mo des pad+ma bstan nas/ /e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas// ci ste cho ga bzhin bsten na/ /de yi mdun na nga 'dug ste/ /sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa/ /bya ba pad+mar ji bzhin byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid de/ / 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /ces gsung bar bsam/ de nas rang gi pang du byon nas/ gnyis ka'i mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bsgom | lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya snyam pa'i bsam pas snyoms par zhugs ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + pas ) / skad cig dang po tsum+ba dang 'khyud pa'i dus su dga' ba'i ye shes nyams su myong*/ gnyis pa bsrub pa dang srub pa'i sbyor ba'i tshe mchog dga' nyams su myong*/ gsum pa phyi'i chags pa dang bral ba'i tshe dga' bral gyi dga' ba nyams su myong*/ bzhi pa rtogs pa thams cad las grol ba'i tshe lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyams su myong bar bsam/ de nyid kyi tshe byang chub kyis sems spyi bo nas babs pa mgrin par sleb pas dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ lte bar dga' bral/ dbang gis gnas su lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ de nas yum gyi khams dang bcas pa rlung gi nus pa yar drang

| lte bar dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ mgrin par dga' bral/ spyi bor lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ de'i tshe lus thams cad thig les gang*/ de thams cad bde bas khyab/ bde ba mi rtog pa dang zung du chud par bsgoms la sems mnyam par bzhag go /kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yogs phye/ de nas dbang de'i mtha' rten dbugs dbyung ba ni/ bla mas/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/ khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsung bar bsam la/ de'i don dran par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi lus bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la phul bar bsam zhing | sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa'i/ /slob ma 'di ni phul ba lags | | zhes brjod/ slar yang bla ma'i zhal nas/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bris/ khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas su/ /sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/ /sngags bshad tshul gyi cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan btags drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun kyang*/ khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ /ces gsungs bar bsam zhing ji skad gsungs pa bzhin bsgrub par khas blangs par bsam mo/ /'bras bu'i dus kyi dbugs dbyung ba'o/ /de nas lam dus kyi dbugs dbyung ba ni/ slob dpon smad par mi bya zhing*/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /spun la smad par mi bya zhing*/ /sems can rnams la gdug byams dang*/ /byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ /bdag gzhan chos la smad mi bya/ /skal med de nyid gtam mi bya/ /bdag gi lus la nges mi smad/ /chos la yid gnyis mi bya zhing*//

gdug la byams pa nyid mi bya/ /chos nyid tshad ni gzung mi bya/ /skal ldan ( ¡¶ zha ¡· dman ) sems can spang mi bya/ /dam tshig rtag tu bskyang bar bya/ /bud med nyid la smad mi bya/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dkon mchog gsum ni spang mi bya/ /rtag tu dam tshig bsrung bar bya/ /rdo rje dril bu gzung bar bya/ /gtsug tor rtag tu bcang bar bya/ /rtag tu sbyin sreg dgang bar bya/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bya/ /rtag tu bde gshegs rab gnas bya/ /'byung po che la gtor ma sbyin/ /phyag rgya sbyin pa rnam spang zhing*/ /mchod rten las ni mi bya ste/ / rdo rje gsum mchog phyag mi bya/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs lus kyi las/ /rmi lam du yang mi bya'o/ /slob dpon gzhan la phyag mi bya/ /bla ma rgan rabs phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag par rgyun du sngags bzla zhing*/ /bsam gtan nyid kyang rnam par spyad/ /rtag tu slob ma bsdu bya zhing*/ /rtag pa ru ni bshad pa gyis/ /rtag tu sems can bskyang bar bya/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas cher mnyes bya/ /dzam+bha la la chu sbyin zhing*/ /las rnams thams cad yang dag spyad/ /bye ma'i las la mchod rten yang | | mkhas pas cho ga bzhin du bya/ /zhes bla mas gsung bar bsam zhing*/ de'i don dran par bya'o/ /dbugs dbyung ba'o/ /de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas par bsam/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*/ /de nas bla ma ngo bo nyid kyi skur dmigs nas/ rang mi bskyod pa'i nga rgyal gyis dbang bzhi pa blang ba'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor gyi byang sgor 'dug par bsams la/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bdag nyid che khyod bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*/ /bka' drin gyis ni bskyab tu gsol

| | zhes lan gsumagasol ba btab nas/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yogs bcing bar bsam/ de nas lus skyil krung lag pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya bya/ de nas ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral mthar sbyin zhi ba nyid | khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do/ /zhes gsung bar bsam zhing*/ de'i don yang*/ rang gi sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes spros pa thams cad las grol ba yin par bsams la/ de'i ngang la yid mnyam par bzhag go /de las gnyis su med pa'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur ro/ /don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i brdar gdong g.yogs dbye/ de nas gzengs bstod pa ni/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /btsud pa dang ni mthong ba yis/ / de ring sdig las rnam grol te/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyis ni 'chi ba yod ma yin/ /mi thub pa dang mi chod pa/ / cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /dpal ldan ¡Ã yon tan ( ¡¶ zha ¡· don yod ) 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bdud tshogs kun las nges rgyal te/ /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ /zhes bla mas gsung bar bsam zhing | de'i don yang dran par bya'o/ /gzengs bstod pa'o/ /de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs bsgoms pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas snyam du bsam/ dbang bzhi pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug pa dang*/ dbang blang ba'i cho ga rdzogs so// //de nas dam tshig thams cad bsdus te khas blang ba'i bsam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/

/de nas gtang rag 'bul ba'i don du/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyod kyis slob mar gzung ba dang*/ /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do | | de nas rang dang dkyil 'khor tha mi dad par bsams la/ oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /kye yi rdo rje bdag grub mdzod/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste | | dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa'i mi mnga' rtag pa ste/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes su chags/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs | | kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems su bdag grub mdzod | | dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i mchog | grub pa rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag grub mdzod/ / sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ / ¡Ã sems can kun gyi yid la zhugs/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - sems can la zhugs// ) sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid/ /'dod chags mnyam pa'i dam tshig mchog /ces lan gcig brjod pa'i rjes la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid mthong bar gyur cig ces bsam zhing*/ shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa/ /bden pa de yis mgon bdag la/ khyod kyi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu byung | | de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung*/ /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /dri med kun gyis mthong bar shog/ces lan gsum brjod do/

/de ltar bdag nyid 'jug pa tshar ba dang*/ gtor ma rnams sta gon gyi skabs bzhin du gtang*/ tshogs la longs spyad pa nas lhag ma'i bar sta gon bzhin bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi mjug gi bya ba ni/ dkyil 'khor la mchod pa dang bstod pa byas nas/ bdag la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes dngos grub blang*/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can la sogs pas smon lam gdab/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par badzod/ /ces lan gsum gyis bzod par gsol/ /yi ge brgya pa brjod la cho ga lhag chad kha bskang | ras ris la brten pa yin na ( ¡¶ lu ¡· pas ) gshegs su gsol mi dgos/ de nas gtor ma'i mgron gshegs su gsol/ las kyi rjes bsdu/ rang gi gnas gsum ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - gsum ) bsrung*/ de nas ci bde bar spyod/ mjug gi cho ga'o | | tshul 'di yang nas yang du bdag 'jug gi cho ga blangs nas ring por mi thogs par kye rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + rgyur ) 'gyur ro/ /gsung rab snying po rnal 'byor ¡Ã ma rgyud kyi ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· ma'i ) / /lam gyi snying po dbang nyid yin par gsungs/ /de yi cho ga snying por rab gsal ba/ /'di ni 'phags pa zhes byas legs sbyar nas/ /bsod nams dbang phyug rigs gzugs 'byor ldan zhing*/ /dad ldan blo gros brtse ba'i ngang tshul can/ /rgyal sras jim gyin nyid la 'bul lags kyis/ /kun nas 'dun pa'i thugs kyis bzhes su gsol// dge ba gang zhig tsha zer byed pa yi/ /'od zer lta bu nye bar 'bar ba yis/ /skye rgu'i yid kyi mun pa rab bsal nas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i snang ba thong bar shog | bcom ldan 'das dpal ( ¡¶ lu ¡· - dpal ) kye'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga snying po gsal ba zhes bya ba rgyal bu jim gyin gyis bskul nas/

lung dang rigs pa'i de kho na nyid phyin ci ma log par smra ba/ blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya bas/ lcags pho spre'u'i lo smal po'i zla ba la tshar bar sbyar ba'o// //༄༅/ /lam dus kyi dbang rgyas pa blang ba'i lag len bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /lam dus kyi dbang rgyas pa len par 'dod pas/ skye mched ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + dang ) sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa'i bar/ mngon par rtogs pa ¡Ã rgyas pa ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - rgyas pa ) bzhin bsgom/ de nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug byas pas/ lus kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs par gsal gdab/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ 'og min gyi gnas nas dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ lha mo drug dang bcas shing*/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs la/ dkar mo ri dwags la sogs pas mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rje la sogs pas bstod/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la zhes pa la sogs pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab pa nas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi bar bdag 'jug ltar bya/ 'on kyang rig pa'i dbang lnga'i sangs rgyas rnams phyag gnyis par bsgom/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo ni/ lam gyi chos mtshon par byed pa yin la/ lha rnams ni 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang*/ yon tan mtshon par byed cing*/ de thams cad kyang rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dang gsung dang thugs la tshang ngo zhes pa tsam gyis de kho na nyid dran par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i zhal nas/ khyod kyis phyi dang nang dang de kho na nyid kyi sgo nas phyi dang*/ nang gi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod par gyis zhes mchod pa'i rjes gnang dang*/ gang zag so so'i khams dang bag la nyal dang rjes su (
